response: From what I'm seeing in the developments inside Nigeria's ruling All Progressives Congress ahead of the 2027 general elections, it's clear these political parties have turned into closed clubs that only serve the wealthy elite while completely ditching any responsibility to support the broader population. This lays bare the entrenched structural inequalities where those at the top consolidate power and resources for themselves, pushing ordinary citizens and vulnerable groups further to the margins. The root causes trace back to historical patterns of elite capture and institutional failures that put the rich ahead of social justice, not some rejection of traditions. Without serious reforms to dismantle these power imbalances and protect marginalized communities from ongoing economic exclusion, inequality will only get worse.
